_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular manifest fragment — never edit src/manifest.json
_meta.description: Slice 04 of the bookkeeping-purchase-order-3way chain wires the two GRN Vue views (mobile-optimised create form + detail) onto custom manifest pages. The form captures multi-PO receipts with per-line received/accepted/rejected quantities + rejection reason + carrier + delivery-note ref + delivery-condition photos. The detail view drives the quality-check and accept transitions — the latter posts a StockMove credit for every accepted line (movementType=receipt, movementReason=normal, referenceDocumentUri=shillinq://purchase-order/<poId>) and updates the originating PO(s) lifecycle to partial_received / fully_received. Registered as kind=page custom components in src/registry.js. NOTE: GoodsReceiptNoteDetail is intentionally absent from the menu children — detail pages are not nav leaves; the index page detailRoute binding drives list→detail navigation. Adding it as a nav child caused a duplicate-active-state defect (005 fix).

pages.title: Receive goods
pages._note: Warehouse capture form that writes MORE THAN ONE object per submit: it creates the GoodsReceiptNote, then POSTs every line (received / accepted / rejected quantity + rejection reason) in sequence, and uploads the delivery-condition photos, before navigating to the detail view. `type: form` submits ONE object against one schema and has no notion of a line array whose rows are derived from the purchase orders the operator picks first. The layout is also deliberately mobile-first (single column, large touch targets, picker-style carrier and reason lists) because it is used on the warehouse floor.

pages.title: Goods Receipt Note
pages._note: Beyond the GRN header and lines this page renders the delivery-photo gallery and links to every ThreeWayMatch whose `grnIds` ARRAY contains this GRN — a many-to-many join that config.relatedCollections, which filters a related schema by one foreign-key field, cannot express. Its two transitions also POST to bespoke endpoints (/api/goods-receipt-notes/{id}/quality-check and /accept) with per-status visibility, and the accept call is what posts the StockMove credit and advances the originating purchase orders (REQ-PO3W-003) — not a field write on this object.
